240-5256-5470-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

277-3277-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-3277-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Izzet Chronarch and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Izzet Chronarch and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-3277-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Izzet Chronarch and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

728-6602--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat

206-222-527-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-3899.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

628-3899-7198.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Flitterwing Nuisance.
When Flitterwing Nuisance dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

2034-4275-5003-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
2034-4275-5003-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Repeat.

2626-3652-4986-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

855-3099-3129-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Corpsejack Menace and Primal Vigor.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

140-558-7433.description:
Activate Carrion Howler by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

3175-5617-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

891-2034-2843.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

997-4907-6556-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
997-4907-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

1069-1232-4460-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-4460-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

222-527-6798-7296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.

222-527-6798-7296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2919-5086-5183-6753.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2919-5086-5183-6753.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

2921-5702-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2034-2919-3490-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2034-2919-3490-6458.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2301-4050-4484-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2301-4050-4484-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}.
When Ebondeath dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

437-4222-5268.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

220-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
220-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
220-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to  Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing 100 damage to target opponent.

573-1399-1606-4875.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gruul Turf.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

394-856-2829-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

509-1267-4639-4883.manaNeeded: {1}{U/P}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-4639-4883.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-4639-4883.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

1193-1617-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You have enough mana to cast Mythos of Illuna.
1193-1617-4831-4983-5358.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1193-1617-4831-4983-5358.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

710-2292-2961.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

282-2034-2905-3094.notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness.
282-2034-2905-3094.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Delina's trigger, with the copy targeting Pestermite.
Resolve the copy of Delina's trigger, creating at least one token copy of Pestermite that is tapped and attacking.
When the Pestermite token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Lithoform Engine and up to one other applicable permanent for each remaining trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Pestermite token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

575-3703-4674-4955.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature that does not have Grafted Wargear attached.
You have at least one green card in hand.
575-3703-4674-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Temur Charger.
If Grafted Wargear was attached to a creature, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature.
Grafted Wargear triggers, causing you to sacrifice Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When Temur Charger enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card in your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1424-3459-4321.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Battered Golem.
Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
1424-3459-4321.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token and a Food artifact token.
When the Food enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1282-2034-2131-2178-5319.notablePrerequisites:
Serrated Biskelion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Serrated Biskelion.
Geralf's Messenger does not have more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
1282-2034-2131-2178-5319.description:
Activate Serrated Biskelion by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on it and Geralf's Messenger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger, adding {C}{C}.
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability and Serrated Biskelion trigger.
Resolve the Serrated Biskelion trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Geralf's Messenger trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters the battlefield, it and Thran Vigil trigger.
Resolve the Geralf's Messenger trigger, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Thran Vigil trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Serrated Biskelion.
Repeat.

156-3373.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
156-3373.description:
Cast Scourge of the Skyclaves with kicker by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Scourge of the Skyclaves triggers, causing each player to lose life equal to half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Astarion triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

776-1329-2709-4966.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-2709-4966.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Chrome Mox to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Chrome Mox.
Cast Chrome Mox.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
